summary: The reason I dig an #htmlfirst approach... Give me a piece a paper and 20 minutes and I can teach you to build a website. Will you be able to do everything you can on social media? No but I would never teach you to write a book before learning to write a paragraph.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
The reason I dig an #htmlfirst approach... Give me a piece a paper and 20 minutes and I can teach you to build a website.

Will you be able to do everything you can on social media? No but I would never teach you to write a book before learning to write a paragraph.
